- EOQ of 2805 units exceeds MOQ of 1751, allowing optimization

1. Increase safety stock to 874 units to achieve 95% service level
2. Maintain order quantity at 2805 units (EOQ-based)
3. Set reorder point at 1887 units
4. Focus on reducing lead time variability (primary cost driver)
5. Consider supplier performance improvement initiatives
